imageChangeTitle: Image instead of the name — change or remove
name: Name
fromGone: This menu is from the page {page} — and that page no longer has its own menu, so nothing shows here.
fromPage: This menu is from the page {page} ({count} items). Changes there show here too.
copyHere: Copy them here and change them
none: This page has no menu — and doesn't get one automatically from the page above. Add items or use another page's menu.
useParent: Use the menu of the page {page}
useParentHint: ({count} items; changes there will show here too)
takeOther: Or take the menu from another of your pages
takeOtherHint: The same bar on both pages: what you add there will appear here too. Relative paths still count from that page.
shareable: Another of your pages can show this menu too — it chooses it itself, in its own menu editor. To take a menu from elsewhere instead, remove this one first.
pathsHint: A relative path counts from this page ({path}): “oaza” is {path}/oaza, “../” is the page above. The menu shows only on this page — subpages don't get it automatically. Your other pages (subpages too) can choose it in their menu editor; then they all show the same.
copyParent: Copy the menu of the page above and change it
